boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten named places in Texas A&M’s public Gardens where you can meet, walk, look closely, or take a break without admission.

cards.title: Pause by the Rose Bed
cards.subtitle: Leach Teaching Gardens, Texas A&M University
cards.notes: Meet at the bench beside the rose bed, then take a slow lap through the surrounding teaching gardens before heading to your next stop.
cards.short_summary: A planted rose bed with a bench in the Leach Teaching Gardens.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gardens at Texas A&M state that there is no cost of admission and that the public may visit; the Rose Bed is a named feature of the Leach Teaching Gardens.
cards.source_title: Admission & Hours — The Gardens at Texas A&M University
cards.access_notes: The Gardens are public and open daily from dawn to dusk; leave when it gets dark.

cards.title: Walk the Mexican Heritage Garden
cards.subtitle: Leach Teaching Gardens, Texas A&M University
cards.notes: Use the open plaza and water-feature setting as a calm meetup point, then continue through nearby themed garden paths together.

cards.evidence_claim: The Gardens at Texas A&M state that there is no cost of admission and that the public may visit; the Mexican Heritage Garden is a named feature of the Leach Teaching Gardens.
